claim: L'Air du Temps has 11 on-site bedrooms in a restored white farmstead with garden views; average double-room rate ~€210 incl. breakfast; ranked #2 hotel in Namur district by Quality Lodgings.
quote: Both the restaurant and the rooms exude contemporary class... 5-hectare vegetable garden... The average official price for a Double Room, use incl. breakfast is €210.

claim: Les Ruines du Château is two suites built into the ruins of Château d'Aische-en-Refail, located 500 metres from L'Air du Temps; 20 min from Namur, 40 min from Brussels.
quote: Located 20 minutes from Namur, 15 minutes from Louvain-la-Neuve, 40 minutes from Brussels and 500 metres from l'Air du Temps, we offer you an unusual and comfortable experience in one of our guest rooms.

claim: The two Les Ruines suites are La Charmante (bath + outdoor jacuzzi on terrace by pond) and L'Envoûtante (combined infrared/steam sauna under the castle tower); both with luxury bedding, mini-fridge, TV with Netflix; from ~€200/night.
quote: La Charmante: a room with bathroom (shower + bathtub), outdoor jacuzzi and garden. L'Envoûtante: a room with shower and combined sauna (infrared and steam) under the castle tower.

claim: Château Bayard is a 17th-century family castle in Éghezée with five bedrooms preserving period fireplaces, stuccoes and Louis XVI alcoves; three 'prestige' rooms (Opaline, Emperor, Queen's) and two 'charme' rooms (Sunset, Little Prince).
quote: Five magnificent rooms... The bedrooms are located on the first floor of the castle... fireplaces with their overmantels, the stuccoes of the alcoves, and the furniture from that period.

claim: Hotel Les Tanneurs de Namur occupies 15 connected 17th-century houses (former tanneries) preserved with blue-stone, brick vaults and stone arches; 37 individually decorated rooms across zen/business/design/family/suite categories; breakfast €11pp; in old-town Namur.
quote: 15 houses from the 17th century were restored to become a 4-star hotel and restaurants... blue stones, vestiges of ancient tanneries, brick vaults, stone arches.

claim: The Royal Snail is Namur's first boutique design hotel at 22 Avenue de la Plante; five room categories from €135 (Deluxe River Side) to €239 (Royal Package); outdoor pool, spa, jacuzzi, on-site restaurant La Table du Royal Snail.
quote: Five room categories ranging from €135 to €239 per night: Deluxe River Side (€135/night), Deluxe Pool Side (€165), Superior Garden Side (€180), Junior Suites (€215), Royal Package (€239).

claim: Namur-area taxi pricing: ~€11 for 5 km, ~€20 for 10 km, ~€38 for 20 km, ~€94 for 50 km (standard class).
quote: For a standard class taxi in Namur, a 5 km trip would cost approximately 11 EUR, 10 km would cost 20 EUR, 20 km would be 38 EUR, and 50 km would cost 94 EUR.

claim: L'Air du Temps is a two-Michelin-star restaurant (also Green Star) in Liernu, Namur province, in the 2026 Michelin Guide Belgium.
quote: Two MICHELIN Stars: Excellent cooking, worth a detour... Green Star.

claim: L'Air du Temps relocated to the Liernu farmstead in 2013; chef Sang Hoon Degeimbre operates with a team of ~20; the property overlooks a 5-hectare vegetable garden used as menu inspiration.
quote: Le restaurant a déménagé en 2013 dans une ferme à Liernu... Sang Hoon Degeimbre y travaille avec une équipe d'une vingtaine de personnes.

claim: Château Bayard charges ~€190 per room per night, with breakfast buffet at €15pp; booking is by email only (chambre-chateau-bayard@gmail.com); check-in from 16:00, check-out 11:00.
quote: The average rate per night at Le Château Bayard is 190€ for the room... breakfast is €15 per person, buffet style... reservation, simply send an e-mail to the address chambre-chateau-bayard@gmail.com.

claim: Charmes d'Hôtes is a countryside guesthouse at Rue du Try Lambord 60, 5030 Grand-Leez (Gembloux), 'at the gates of Gembloux' and ~15 minutes from Namur; offers table d'hôtes and large garden; adjacent to Château de Petit-Leez.
quote: At the gates of Gembloux... 15 minutes from Namur... comfortable, warm, welcoming and full of charm... Proximity to Château de Petit-Leez.

claim: Château de Namur is a 4-star hotel atop the Citadelle de Namur with 29 rooms incl. 5 suites in four categories (20–35 m²); cable car ~7 min to old town; free parking; Green Key certified.
quote: The highest hotel & restaurant in Namur... 29 rooms, including 5 suites... A cable car connects it to the city center in approximately 7 minutes.

claim: Maredsous Abbey hosts a 4-star hotel (32 rooms in main building, 20-room annex Hôtel du Moulin) — used here only to indicate the distance ruling Maredsous out of taxi range.
quote: Beautiful 4-star hotel offering elegant accommodation in picturesque surroundings between Namur and Dinant with 32 rooms in the main building.

claim: Château de Petit-Leez is a 17th-century Mosan château-farm in Gembloux with a 5-hectare park and contemporary art centre EXIT 11, but does not offer overnight accommodation.
quote: Built in the 17th century and enlarged and slightly modified in the 18th and 19th centuries, the château-farm testifies to Mosan architecture... Free access from Thursday to Sunday.
